subtitle: Five exercises on the text

review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Mia wants to see the elephants.
Mia wears a pink shirt and blue shorts.
Mia's shoes are under the table.
Mom tells Mia not to forget her hat.
Mia takes an apple for a snack.
Mia goes to the zoo without her sunglasses.
Where are Mia and Mom going today?
What does Mia put in her backpack?

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Mia and Mom are going to the zoo. Mia gets ready: she puts on her clothes, her shoes and her hat, and she takes water, a snack and her sunglasses. She hopes to see elephants, monkeys and giraffes.
Her pink shirt, her blue shorts, her shoes and her hat.

items.q: What does Mia take in her backpack?
items.model: Her water bottle and a banana.

items.q: Which animals does Mia want to see?
items.model: The elephants, the monkeys and the giraffes.

items.q: What animal do you want to see at the zoo? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Mia finds her shoes under the bed
Mia takes a banana for a snack
Mia finds her sunglasses on the table
